definitions.title: Tangent Plane to a Surface
definitions.statement: The tangent plane to the surface z = f(x, y) at P_0(x_0, y_0, z_0) is the plane containing all tangent lines to curves on the surface through P_0. For level surface F(x, y, z) = c, equation is grad F(P_0) . (r - r_0) = 0.
definitions.explanation: Provides the best linear approximation to the curved surface near the point of tangency.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Normal vector to the tangent plane of z = f(x, y) is <f_x, f_y, -1>.

definitions.title: Linearization and Total Differential
definitions.latex: L(x, y) = f(x_0, y_0) + f_x(x_0, y_0)(x - x_0) + f_y(x_0, y_0)(y - y_0), \quad dz = f_x dx + f_y dy
definitions.statement: The linearization L(x, y) is the linear function whose graph is the tangent plane. The total differential dz approximates the actual change Delta z = f(x_0+dx, y_0+dy) - f(x_0, y_0) for small increments dx, dy.
definitions.explanation: Error Delta z - dz approaches 0 faster than distance sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Used extensively for error propagation and linear sensitivity analysis.
